title: 粗码：为什么越省力分得越粗，而核实总是慢半拍 / Coarse Codes: Why Saving Effort Makes Us Coarser, and Why Verification Always Lags
description:
中文摘要。同一份力气，花在两个地方，会得到两种完全不同的结果。时间紧、睡得少、后果重的时候，人不是变懒了，而是把有限的码率换了一种花法：环境宽的时候缩支撑，只剩一条隧道；环境窄的时候缩刻度，糊成一片。这本书从一条驻点式开始——在失真与码率的交换里求极小，得 v∗=(T+λ)/(2w)——把它推到个人、群体、社会三层，再在文明层放四根外接立柱。全书七部分二十八章，从“两种人是一个错误的起点”讲起，到“这本书在哪里停”收束。它有推导，也有能复算的数：两万余条核实记录、三百九十八个古政体的公开编码、两百六十六个法规节级的修订间隔、一百二十五个国家的历法采纳年份、十二万四千条义项清单。所有数字标 A/B/C 等级；结论强度不超过证据强度。

核心主张。一条规则＝状态空间上的一次划分；理解＝估计这个划分；在“错了有多疼”与“分细要多少钱”之间取驻点，就得到分辨率。由这一条可推：覆盖面翻倍、精度减半（δ=Δ/2^R）；把切点的描述费写进总账，就得两条标度律（赌注抬十倍，类别数涨 √10 或 ∛10）；换码要付一次成本，于是同一件事去程与回程不对称（带宽＝2C）。六个标签读成两条原理＋四个接触面：原理一是预算下的划分极小化，原理二是账可外置、权重可为负；接触面是价格、切法、群体、账。P5 不是公设，是“世界会变”这句描述世界的话。

结构与证据。七部分各四章：起点与预算；看见与记住；群体与标签；社会与核实；历史与人物；文明与边界；收束与缺口。附录 A–F 只放式子、边界条件、否证线、登记簿与指针，叙述都在正文。证据分三档：A 官方可复现、B 稳定公开估计、C 稀疏／构造／思辨。全书 117 张表、41 幅图；每张图表都写清数据来源、质量等级与边界声明；实证读数包括：PolitiFact 两万余条核实记录（中位 4.4 天，滞后分布第二个峰落在 7.2 天——那是工作周，不是层级）；Seshat 398 个政体上“行政层级数只随人口走”（每十倍 +3.5 层），文字只在“标准单位”“文本类型”两块上留下正号，而只数直接观测条目时正号消失；eCFR 266 个节级修订间隔的突发度 B=−0.20（比随机更规则，说明闸口被排班盖住）；125 国历法采纳 B=+0.52（成团的是复位，不是阈值）。

本版修订。本版（2026-11-18）相对 2026-11-16 的稿有六处改动：一、版式——117 张表此前没有套上三线表样式（无线框、单元格挤在一起），本版全部改用系列版式；54 个公式从“居中段落”改为带式号的公式版式（(.eq)，右端编号），长注与长框允许跨页，页底不再留半页空白；二、颗粒度——短段接成论述段、相邻同主线小节并节，正文段落中位从 68 字升到 136 字，27／28 章落在 8—10 节，“一、二、三”式条目从段中拆回段首；三、符号——把四处共用的 d 拆开：d∗ 可分辨阈值、τ 核实延迟、⟨k⟩ 度、ζ 套利折损系数，d′ 保留，全库不再有裸 d；四、内容补写——第 9 章补上“码＝先验”的桥（(μ, σ) 与两轴的关系、改码与更新的区别），第 6 章补“无文字社会”与样本偏倚，第 5 章补计价单位与 z 缺口的新状态，第 28 章给两个突发度读数补零分布与区间（p<10⁻⁴），附录 F 新增 F.7“二十条可检验预言”台账；五、可核性——95 条表注逐条补快照日，术语表从 16 条扩到 33 条（书末索引由此生成）；六、收口——引用缺口 0、悬空节引用 0、标签不平衡 0、表号与图号连续。七、副题重写——从“省力如何改变理解，核实如何追上”改为“为什么越省力分得越粗，而核实总是慢半拍”：前者说的是机制，后者说的是读者的问题，后者更像一本书的名字。八、按外部审阅补六处——表 4.5 加“可测代理”一列（六核心各拿什么读）；第 12 章加“改基线 vs 准备窗口”的区分（悲观变成精确）；第 13 章给出“公开表现与私下响应的散度 DKL(A‖K)”这一可测定义（并写明它的两个边界）；第 20 章与第 8 章对齐（迟滞的存在可推、宽度是 C 级）；第 21 章标明“写作时点本身是一个采样点”（2026 的快照十年后可被回看检验）；第 7 章加“不是换词”的三条操作性判据。九、书名改为《粗码》——系列里唯一一件用自造词做正题的书；副题改为“为什么越省力分得越粗，而核实总是慢半拍”。十、补了“操作者”这一层：第 9 章补七位（柏拉图到图灵）对 μ 轴的七个动作，第 16 章补四位（林肯、甘地、曼德拉、路德）对“信任怎么被生产”的四个动作，第 19 章补四位（古腾堡、征信、核查与 GDPR、AI）对核实成本结构的动作，第 21 章补五位（汉谟拉比、科举、拿破仑法典、人权宣言、三大宗教）对规则谱与分类器的动作；第 24 章新增表 24.6 把二十个操作者一次列全（全 C 级，AI 一处 B 级），并配一条共同否证线。第 10／13／18 章各加一段 AI 的投影（外置记忆、粗码工业化、核实军备竞赛），正式位置在第 19 章。

诚实纪律。三句话：结论强度不超过证据强度；不可测就说不可测；失败与反例照实写在正文。全书 13 条查不到公开出处的断言逐条降为情景并列入附录 F；第 26 章单列九处空白——前三件缺数据、后三件缺概念——并给出“再做一次十倍的数据能不能答上”这一条判据。并置不是检验：把两套理论摆在一张表上只说明它有位置，不说明它被验过。反身性写成方向＋条件，不写成宿命。

边界。本书不写人群（代际与性别只作背景，不点人群、不给频率、不做因果）；不做国别排名；不评价政策；语义内容仍空（模型能说“这番话让听众的码变粗了”，说不出“为什么是这一句”）；“为什么是这个人”（执行者）不在式子里，只作边界；私有表征不可观测，与折旧挂钩而不单独建模。凡超出这五条的话，本书只当情景，不当结论。

版本信息。2026-11-18；483 页（印刷版 A4，含封面）；七部分二十八章；正文 264 节＋附录 46 节；119 表／41 图；正文 249,141 汉字（另附录、前置、后置与部分导语）。内容 CC BY 4.0。本件为《有限系统的取舍》系列第十册，尚未登记 DOI（未进 inventory.tsv）。

系列。本件是系列的第十册，与已发布的二十四件（九书＋十五篇论文＋合集）共用同一母题：复杂系统如何保持结构、如何变化、如何生成新结构。它与《遗忘的边界》共用“码的折旧”，与《选择的代价》共用“换码的成本”，与《区分的语言》共用“划分与对称性”，与《涌现的临界》共用“迟滞与阈值”。“看见、记住、跟上、选择、讲述、临界”六个核心各落一章，不把六个提问当裁判。

Abstract.The same effort, spent in two different places, buys two entirely different results. Under time pressure, sleep debt, and high stakes, people do not become lazy: they spend a limited code budget differently. When the environment is wide, they narrow the support and keep one tunnel; when it is narrow, they coarsen the resolution and everything blurs together. The book starts from a single first-order condition (v∗ = (T+λ)/(2w)) and carries it through the individual, the group and the society, with four external pillars at the civilisational layer. Seven parts, twenty-eight chapters, from “two kinds of people is the wrong starting point” to “where this book stops”. It contains derivations and reproducible numbers: twenty thousand verification records, 398 ancient polities, 266 regulation-level revision intervals, 125 calendar adoptions, 124 thousand dictionary senses. Every number carries an A/B/C grade; conclusions never exceed the evidence.

Core claims.A rule is a partition of a state space; understanding is estimating that partition; taking the optimum between “how much it hurts to be wrong” and “what it costs to be fine” yields resolution. Consequences: doubling coverage halves precision (δ=Δ/2^R); pricing the description of cut points yields two scaling laws (a tenfold stake raises the number of categories by √10 or ∛10); switching codes costs once, so the way in and the way out are asymmetric (band width = 2C). Six tags read as two principles plus four contact surfaces: the first principle is partition minimisation under a budget; the second is that the bill can be externalised and weights can be negative; the contact surfaces are price, cut, group, and account.

Structure and evidence.Seven parts of four chapters each, appendices A–F restricted to expressions, boundary conditions, falsification lines and registers. Evidence is graded A (official and reproducible), B (stable public estimate), C (sparse, constructed, or speculative). Readings include: PolitiFact verification records (median 4.4 days; the second peak of the lag distribution sits at 7.2 days, which is the work week, not a hierarchy level); 398 Seshat polities where the number of administrative levels follows population only (+3.5 levels per tenfold) while writing leaves its mark only on “standard units” and “text type”, and that mark vanishes when only directly observed entries are counted; 266 eCFR section-level intervals with burstiness B = −0.20; 125 calendar adoptions with B = +0.52.

This edition.First edition, 2026-11-18. Relative to the 2026-11-16 draft: short paragraphs were joined into argument paragraphs and adjacent sub-sections on the same thread were merged, raising the median paragraph length from 68 to 141 characters and bringing 27 of 28 chapters into the 8–10 section band (482 printed pages, down from 510); the symbol d, which carried four meanings, was split into d∗ (resolvability threshold), τ (verification lag), ⟨k⟩ (degree) and ζ (arbitrage decay), keeping d′ for signal-detection sensitivity, so no bare d remains; a cover and an aligned four-level table of contents were added; citation gaps, dangling section references, and unbalanced HTML tags are all at zero. The typographic repair was the largest change: none of the 117 tables had been carrying the series table style, and the 54 display formulas were re-set as numbered display equations. Two conceptual bridges were added (codes as priors in chapter 9; societies without writing in chapter 6), the two burstiness readings now carry their null distributions (p<10⁻⁴), and appendix F gained a twenty-item ledger of testable predictions.

Honesty discipline.Three commitments: conclusion strength never exceeds evidence strength; what cannot be measured is said to be unmeasurable; failures and counterexamples are reported in the body, not in footnotes. Thirteen claims without a verifiable source are demoted to scenarios and listed in Appendix F; chapter 26 lists nine gaps — the first three missing data, the last three missing concepts — with a single criterion (would ten times the data answer it?). Juxtaposition is not a test: putting two theories on one table shows where they sit, not that either has been checked. Reflexivity is written as a direction plus a condition, never as destiny.

Boundaries.The book does not write about populations (generation and gender appear only as background); it does not rank countries; it does not evaluate policies. Semantic content remains empty: the model can say “this line coarsened the audience's code” but not “why this sentence”. Why a particular person executes a code is outside the equations; private representations are unobservable and are handled only through depreciation. Anything beyond these boundaries is offered as scenario, not as conclusion.

Edition.2026-11-18; 483 pages (A4 print, cover included); seven parts, twenty-eight chapters; 264 body sections plus 46 appendix sections; 119 tables and 41 figures; 249,141 Chinese characters of body text. Content licensed CC BY 4.0. Item 10 of the series The Tradeoffs of Finite Systems; not yet registered with a DOI.

Series.The tenth item of the series, sharing its motif with the twenty-four published items (nine books, fifteen papers, one collection): how complex systems keep structure, how they change, and how they generate new structure. It shares the depreciation of codes with The Boundary of Forgetting, the cost of switching with The Price of Choice, partition and symmetry with The Language of Distinction, and hysteresis with The Criticality of Emergence. The six cores — seeing, remembering, keeping up, choosing, telling, criticality — each anchor a chapter; they are six questions, not six criteria.
